G1664.def:
**Ἐλιούδ**, ὁ
indecl.,
**Eliud, an ancestor of Jesus**: [[Mat.1.14-15|Mat.1:14-15]]†
(AS)

G1646.def:
**ἐλάχιστος**, -η, -ον
(see: ἐλάσσων),
**smallest, least**: as proper superlat., [[1Co.15.9|1Co.15:9]] elsewhere, as usually in late Gk., intensive (B1., § 11, 3); [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] (LXX) [[Mat.25.40, 45|Mat.25:40, 45]] [[Luk.12.26; 16.10; 19.17|Luk.12:26 16:10 19:17]], [[1Co.4.3; 6.2|1Co.4:3 6:2]], [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]]; ἐ. ἐν τ. βασιλείᾳ τ. οὐρανῶν, [[Mat.5.19|Mat.5:19]] (see Dalman, _Words_, 113). Compar., ἐλαχιστότερος (for corresp. superl., see LS; see also Bl., § 44, 3); less than the least: [[Eph.3.8|Eph.3:8]]†
(AS)

G1607.def:
**ἐκ-πορεύω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
**to make to go out**; pass. and mid., **to go forth**: [[Luk.3.7|Luk.3:7]], [[Act.25.4|Act.25:4]]; of demons leaving one possessed, [[Mat.17.21|Mat.17:21]] (WH om.), [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]] of excrement, Mk 719; before ἀπό, [[Mat.20.29|Mat.20:29]], [[Mrk.10.46|Mrk.10:46]]; ἐκ, [[Mrk.13.1|Mrk.13:1]] (of the dead rising, [[Jhn.5.29|Jhn.5:29]]); ἐκεῖθεν, [[Mrk.6.11|Mrk.6:11]] ἔξω, [[Mrk.11.19|Mrk.11:19]] είς, [[Mrk.10.17|Mrk.10:17]], [[Jhn.5.29|Jhn.5:29]]; ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[Rev.16.14|Rev.16:14]] πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.3.5|Mat.3:5]], [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]]; εἰσπορ- (which see) καὶ ἐ., [[Act.9.28|Act.9:28]] metaphorically, **to come forth, proceed**: of feelings, etc., [[Mrk.7.23|Mrk.7:23]] before ἐκ, [[Mat.15.11, 18|Mat.15:11, 18]] [[Mrk.7.15, 20-21|Mrk.7:15, 20-21]], [[Luk.4.22|Luk.4:22]], [[Eph.4.29|Eph.4:29]]; ῥῆμα, before διά, [[Mat.4.4|Mat.4:4]] (LXX); of lightning and flame, [[Rev.4.5; 9.17-18; 11.5|Rev.4:5 9:17-18 11:5]]; a river, [[Rev.22.1|Rev.22:1]] a sword, [[Rev.1.16; 19.15|Rev.1:16 19:15]]; a rumour, before εἰς, [[Luk.4.37|Luk.4:37]] of the Holy Spirit, before παρά, [[Jhn.15.26|Jhn.15:26]]†
(AS)

G1654.def:
**ἐλεημοσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(ἐλεέω), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד, צְדָקָה ;]
1. mercy, pity.
2. **almsgiving, alms **(like the German Almosen, a corruption of the Greek word ἐ): [[Mat.6.4|Mat.6:4]] ποιεῖν ἐ., [[Mat.6.2-3|Mat.6:2-3]], [[Act.9.36; 10.2; 24.17|Act.9:36 10:2 24:17]]; ἐ. διδόναι, [[Luk.11.41|Luk.11:41]] (cf. [[Mat.23.36|Mat.23:36]] Dalman, _Words_, 62 f.) 12:33; αἰτεῖν, [[Act.3.2|Act.3:2]] λαβεῖν, [[Act.3.3|Act.3:3]] πρὸς (in order to ask) ἐ., [[Act.3.10|Act.3:10]] pl., [[Act.10.4, 31|Act.10:4, 31]] (Cremer, 711).†
(AS)

G1689.def:
**ἐμ-βλέπω **
[in LXX for רָאָה, [[1Ki.8.8|3Ki.8:8]], al.), פָּנָה ([[Job.6.28|Job.6:28]] A, al.); metaphorically, [[Isa.51.1|Isa.51:1]] (נָבַט hi.), [[Sir.2.10|Sir.2:10]], etc. ;]
**to look at**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.25|Mrk.8:25]] with dative of person(s) (part., before λέγει, εἶπεν, cf. Xen., Cyr., i, 3, 2), [[Mat.19.26|Mat.19:26]], [[Mrk.10.21, 27; 14.67|Mrk.10:21, 27 14:67]], [[Luk.20.17; 22.61|Luk.20:17 22:61]] (ἐνέβλεψεν), [[Jhn.1.36, 43|Jhn.1:36, 43]]; absol., to look, [[Act.22.11|Act.22:11]] metaphorically, **to consider**: [[Mat.6.26|Mat.6:26]]†
(AS)

G1605.def:
**ἐκ-πλήσσω**
(Attic -ττω, [[Act.13.12|Act.13:12]]), [in LXX: (pass.) [[Ecc.7.16|Ecc.7:16]], (שָׁמֵם hithp.), [[Wis.13.4|Wis.13:4]], [[2Ma.7.12|2Ma.7:12]], [[4Ma.8.4|4Ma.8:4]] [[4Mac.17.16|4Mac 17:16]] * ;]
1. prop., **to strike out, drive away**.
2. **to strike with panic or shock, to amaze, astonish**: pass., [[Mat.13.54; 19.25|Mat.13:54 19:25]], [[Mrk.6.2; 7.37; 10.26|Mrk.6:2 7:37 10:26]], [[Luk.2.48|Luk.2:48]]; before ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), [[Mat.7.28; 22.33|Mat.7:28 22:33]], [[Mrk.1.22; 11.18|Mrk.1:22 11:18]], [[Luk.4.32; 9.43|Luk.4:32 9:43]], [[Act.13.12|Act.13:12]].†
_SYN._: " πτωεῖν G?, _to terrify, agitate with fear_;
τρεμεῖν, **to tremble**, predominantly physical;
φοβεῖν, **to fear**, "the general term," Thayer;
cf. also φρίσσω, **to shudder**, and see: δειλία
**δειλία**, -ας, ἡ
(δειλός), [in LXX for אֵימָה, מְחִתָּה, etc. ;]
**cowardice, timidity** (never in good sense): [[2Ti.1.7|2Ti.1:7]]†
_SYN._: φόβος, _fear_, in general, good or bad; εὐλάβεια (which see), apprehension generally, but chiefly _pious fear_, "that careful and watchful reverence which pays regard to every circumstance in that with which it has to deal" (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § x).† (AS)

G1614.def:
**ἐκ-τείνω **
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, נָטָה, etc. ;]
**to stretch out or forth**: τ. χεῖρα (as often in LXX), [[Mat.8.3; 12.13; 14.31; 26.51|Mat.8:3 12:13 14:31 26:51]], [[Mrk.1.41; 3.5|Mrk.1:41 3:5]], [[Luk.5.13; 6.10|Luk.5:13 6:10]] [[Jhn.21.18|Jhn.21:18]], [[Act.26.1|Act.26:1]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), towards, [[Mat.12.49|Mat.12:49]] against, [[Luk.22.53|Luk.22:53]] εἰς ἴασιν, [[Act.4.30|Act.4:30]] of anchors, to cast, [[Act.27.30|Act.27:30]]†
(AS)

G1656.def:
**ἔλεος**, -ους, τό
(cl. -ου, ὁ, and so Rec., [[Mat.9.13; 12.7; 23.23|Mat.9:13 12:7 23:23]], [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]], [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]]; on the Hellenistic form τό ἔ., see WH, _App._, 158; M, _Pr._, 60; Mayser, 277; Kühner, i, 515), [in LXX chiefly for חֶסֶד ;]
**mercy, pity, compassion**;
1. **of men**: [[Mat.9.13|Mat.9:13]] (LXX) [[Mat.12.7; 23.23|Mat.12:7 23:23]]; ποιεῖν ἔ. (and id. before μετά, with genitive; cf. _Heb._ עִם חֶסֶד עָשָׂה, [[Gen.21.23|Gen.21:23]], al.), [[Luk.10.37|Luk.10:37]], [[Jas.2.13; 3.17|Jas.2:13 3:17]].
2. **Of God**: [[Luk.1.50, 54; 1.58|Luk.1:50, 54 1:58]], [[Rom.15.9|Rom.15:9]], [[Eph.2.4|Eph.2:4]], [[2Ti.1.16; 1.18|2Ti.1:16 1:18]], [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]], [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]], [[1Pe.1.3|1Pe.1:3]]; esp. in benedictions, [[Gal.6.16|Gal.6:16]], [[1Ti.1.2|1Ti.1:2]], [[2Ti.1.2|2Ti.1:2]], [[2Jn.3|2Jn.3]], [[Jude.2|Ju 2]]; σκευὴ ἐλέους, [[Rom.9.23|Rom.9:23]] σπλάγχνα ἐλέους, [[Luk.1.78|Luk.1:78]] ποιεῖν ἔ. (see supr.), [[Luk.1.72|Luk.1:72]] τ. ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει, [[Rom.11.31|Rom.11:31]]
3. **Of Christ**: [[Jude.21|Ju 21]].†
_SYN._: οἰκτιρμός (see: ἐλεέω) (AS)

G1632.def:
**ἐκ-χέω ** also Hellenistic, ἐκχύνω (in _Th._: [[2Ki.14.14|4Ki.14:14]] *), and ἐκχύννω (which see)
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַךְ ;]
**to pour out**: φιάλην, [[Rev.16.1-4, 8; 16.10, 12; 16.17|Rev.16:1-4, 8 16:10, 12 16:17]]; κέρματα, [[Jhn.2.15|Jhn.2:15]] αἷμα, [[Mat.23.35|Mat.23:35]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xii), [[Luk.11.50|Luk.11:50]], [[Act.22.20|Act.22:20]], [[Rom.3.15|Rom.3:15]]" (LXX) [[Rev.16.6|Rev.16:6]] Pass., αἷμα, [[Mat.26.28|Mat.26:28]], [[Mrk.14.24|Mrk.14:24]], [[Act.22.20|Act.22:20]]; οἶνος, [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], [[Luk.5.37|Luk.5:37]]; σπλάγχνα, [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]] Metaphorical, τ. πνεῦμα, [[Act.2.17-18|Act.2:17-18]] (LXX), [[Act.2.33; 10.45|Act.2:33 10:45]], [[Tit.3.6|Tit.3:6]]; ἀγάπη, [[Rom.5.5|Rom.5:5]] (cf. [[Sir.36.8|Sir.36:8]], ὀργήν); pass., of persons (like Lat. effundor), **to give oneself up to **(RV, ran riotously in): [[Jude.11|Ju 11]].†
(AS)

G1690.def:
**ἐμ-βριμάομαι** (T, -έομαι; Bl., § 22, 1), -ῶμαι
(βρίμη, strength, bulk, whence βριμάομαι, to snort with anger),
depon., with aor. mid. and pass.,
[in LXX (Hatch, _Essays_, 25): Dan LXX 11:30 (also Aq., [[Psa.7.12|Psa.7:12]] Sm., [[Isa.17.13|Isa.17:13]]) * ;]
to snort in (of horses, Æsch.), hence, to speak or act with deep feeling (_DCG_, i, 62b);
(a) to be moved with anger (cf. ἐμβρίμημα, [[Lam.2.6|La 2:6]]): with dative, [[Mrk.14.5|Mrk.14:5]], [[Jhn.11.33|Jhn.11:33]]; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[Jhn.11.38|Jhn.11:38]]
(b) **to admonish sternly**: with dative, [[Mat.9.30|Mat.9:30]], [[Mrk.1.43|Mrk.1:43]].†
(AS)

G1621.def:
**ἐκ-τινάσσω **
[in LXX for נָעַר ni., pi., etc. ;]
**to shake off**: κονιορτόν, [[Mat.10.14|Mat.10:14]] χοῦν, [[Mrk.6.11|Mrk.6:11]] Mid.: κονιορτόν, [[Act.13.51|Act.13:51]] ἱμάτια, [[Act.18.6|Act.18:6]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, iii).†
(AS)

G1645.def:
**ἐλαφρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for קַל, קָלָל ;]
**light in weight easy to bear**: [[Mat.11.30|Mat.11:30]] θλίψρις (EV, our light affliction), [[2Co.4.17|2Co.4:17]]†
(AS)

G1679.def:
**ἐλπίζω **
[in LXX chiefly for בָּטַח, also for חָסָה, יָחַל pi., hi., etc. ;]
**to look for, expect, hope **(for): with accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.8.24-25|Rom.8:24-25]], [[1Co.13.7|1Co.13:7]], [[Heb.11.1|Heb.11:1]]; with dative of thing(s) (τ. τύχῃ, Thuc., iii, 97, 2), [[Mat.12.21|Mat.12:21]] before καθώς, [[2Co.8.5|2Co.8:5]] with inf., [[Luk.6.34; 23.8|Luk.6:34 23:8]], [[Act.26.7|Act.26:7]], [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]], [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]], [[2Co.5.11|2Co.5:11]], [[Php.2.19, 23|Php.2:19, 23]], [[1Ti.3.14|1Ti.3:14]], [[2Jn.12|II Jn 12]], [[3Jn.14|3Jn.14]]; before ὅτι, with pres., [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]] with fut., [[Act.24.26|Act.24:26]], [[2Co.1.13; 13.6|2Co.1:13 13:6]], Phm 22. As in LXX (WM, § xxxiii, d; and esp. in the pf., Ellic. on [[1Ti.4.10|1Ti.4:10]] Bl., § 59, 2), with prep.; εἰς, [[Jhn.5.45|Jhn.5:45]] (see Ellis., l.with), [[1Pe.3.5|1Pe.3:5]] before ὅτι, [[2Co.1.10|2Co.1:10]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Rom.15.12|Rom.15:12]] (LXX [[1Ti.4.10; 6.17|1Ti.4:10 6:17]]; ἐν, [[1Co.15.19|1Co.15:19]] with accusative, [[1Pe.1.13|1Pe.1:13]] (aor. imper. see Bl., § 58, 2); τ. θεόν, [[1Ti.5.5|1Ti.5:5]] (of. ἀπ-, προ-ελπίζω, see Cremer, 255).†
(AS)

G1651.def:
**ἐλέγχω**
[in LXX chiefly for יָכַח hi. ;]
1. in Hom., to treat with contempt.
2. **to convict**: with accusative, [[Mat.18.15|Mat.18:15]] (RV, show him his fault), [[Tit.1.9|Tit.1:9]] before περί, [[Jhn.8.46; 16.8|Jhn.8:46 16:8]], [[Jude.15|Ju 15]]; pass., [[Jas.2.9|Jas.2:9]]
3. **to reprove, re­buke**: [[1Ti.5.20|1Ti.5:20]], [[2Ti.4.2|2Ti.4:2]], [[Tit.1.13; 2.15|Tit.1:13 2:15]], [[Rev.3.19|Rev.3:19]]; pass., before περί, [[Luk.3.19|Luk.3:19]] ὑπό, [[Heb.12.5|Heb.12:5]] (LXX).
4. **to expose**: [[Eph.5.11|Eph.5:11]] pass., [[Jhn.3.20|Jhn.3:20]], [[1Co.14.24|1Co.14:24]] (RV reprove, mg. convict), [[Eph.5.13|Eph.5:13]] (RV, as 1 Co, l.with, of. AR on [[Eph.5.11|Eph.5:11]] MM, _Exp._, xii; cf. ἐξ-, δια-κατ-ελέγχομαι).†
_SYN._: ἐπιτιμῶ, expressing simply rebuke, which may be un­deserved ([[Mat.16.22|Mat.16:22]]) or ineffectual ([[Luk.23.40|Luk.23:40]]), while ἐλ. implies rebuke which brings conviction (see Tr., _Syn._, § iv) (AS)

G1623.def:
**ἐκτός**,
_ adv._ [in LXX [[Jdg.8.26; 20.15|Jdg.8:26 20:15]], [[1Ki.10.13|3Ki.10:13]], al. (בַּד, [[Jdg.5.28|Jdg.5:28]] (בַּד), בַּד), [[Sng.4.1-3|Sng.4:1-3]] (בַּד), al, ;]
1. as adv., **outside, beyond**: τὸ ἐ., with poss. genitive, the outside, [[Mat.23.26|Mat.23:26]] in late Gk. (see Deiss., BS, 118), pleonastic, ἐκτός εἰ μή, [[1Co.14.5; 15.2|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1Ti.5.19|1Ti.5:19]].
2. With force of prep., with genitive;
(a) **outside of**: [[1Co.6.18|1Co.6:18]], [[2Co.12.2|2Co.12:2]];
(b) **beyond, besides, except**: [[Act.26.22|Act.26:22]], [[1Co.15.27|1Co.15:27]].†
(AS)

G1638.def:
**ἐλαιών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἐλαία), [in LXX for זַיִת ;]
**olive-grove, olive-garden **(so in FlJ and in π.; Deiss., BS, 209 ff.; MM, _Exp._, iii; M, _Pr._, 49, 69, 235): [[Luk.19.29; 21.37|Luk.19:29 21:37]] (WH, -ῶν; see their _App._, 158; Field, _Notes_, 73; El., § 10, 5; 33, 1; Thayer, see word), [[Act.1.12|Act.1:12]] (where EL, ll with, proposes the conjectural emendation ἐλαιῶν for -ῶνος).†
(AS)

G1622.def:
1. **outside **, opposite to ἐντός:
2. as _preposition_ with _genitive_ **outside, out of, far from **, with _genitive_, (Homer): **outside of, free from **, (Herdotus Historicus), attic; ἐκτὸς ἐλπίδος **beyond ** hope, Lat. _praeter spem_, (Sophocles Tragicus)
3. of Time, **beyond **, (Herdotus Historicus)
4. **except **, ἐκτὸς ὀλίγων (Xenophon Historicus)
5. _absolute_, τὰ ἐκτός **external things **, (Euripides)
6. with Verbs of motion, ῥίπτειν ἐκτός to throw **out **, (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. (ML)

G1631.def:
**ἐκ-φύω **
[in OT (Sm.) [[Psa.104.14|Psa.104:14]] (Al.) [[Isa.61.11|Isa.61:11]] * ;]
**to cause to grow out, put forth **(leaves): [[Mat.24.32|Mat.24:32]], [[Mrk.13.28|Mrk.13:28]].†
(AS)

G1637.def:
**ἔλαιον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶן ;]
**olive-oil**: [[Luk.16.6|Luk.16:6]], [[Rev.6.6; 18.13|Rev.6:6 18:13]]; for lamps, [[Mat.25.3-4|Mat.25:3-4]], 8; for healing, [[Mrk.6.13|Mrk.6:13]], [[Luk.10.34|Luk.10:34]], [[Jhn.5.14|Jhn.5:14]]; for anointing at feasts, [[Luk.7.46|Luk.7:46]], [[Heb.1.9|Heb.1:9]]" (LXX) .†
_SYN._: μύρον, ointment, see Tr., _Syn._, 135 (AS)

G1686.def:
**ἐμ-βάπτω **
**to dip in**: τ. χεῖρα ἐν τ. τρυβλίῳ, [[Mat.26.23|Mat.26:23]] mid., before εἰς, [[Mrk.14.20|Mrk.14:20]]†
(AS)

G1611.def:
**ἔκ-στασις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξίστημι) [in LXX: [[Gen.27.33|Gen.27:33]], [[1Sa.14.15|1Ki.14:15]], [[Ezk.26.16|Eze.26:16]], al. (חֲרָדָה); [[2Ch.14.14; 17.10; 20.29|2Ch.14:14 17:10 20:29]] (פַּחַד), al. ;]
1. **a displacement** (Arist.).
2. **An abnormal condition of the mind, in which the subject passes out of his usual self-control **(Hippocr.); in NT (Kennedy, _Sources_, 121 f.);
(a) **a trance**: [[Act.10.10; 11.5; 22.17|Act.10:10 11:5 22:17]];
(b) **amazement**: [[Mrk.5.42; 16.8|Mrk.5:42 16:8]], [[Luk.5.26|Luk.5:26]], [[Act.3.19|Act.3:19]].†
(AS)

G1643.def:
**ἐλαύνω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.41.7|Isa.41:7]] (הָלַם) [[Isa.33.21|Isa.33:21]] (שַׁיִט), etc. ;]
**to drive**: of the wind, [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]], [[2Pe.2.17|2Pe.2:17]]; of sailors rowing or sailing a boat, [[Mrk.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[Jhn.6.19|Jhn.6:19]]; of demons, [[Luk.8.29|Luk.8:29]] (cf. ἀπ-, συν-ελαύνω).†
(AS)

G1674.def:
**Ἑλληνίς**
[in LXX: [[2Ma.6.8|2Ma.6:8]] A * ;]
a Greek (i.e. Gentile) woman: [[Mrk.7.26|Mrk.7:26]], [[Act.17.12|Act.17:12]].†
(AS)

G1627.def:
**ἐκ-φέρω **
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;]
1. **to carry out, bring out**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.15.22|Luk.15:22]], [[1Ti.6.7|1Ti.6:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]], [[Act.5.15|Act.5:15]]; of the dead for burial (cf. κομίζω), [[Act.5.6, 9-10|Act.5:6, 9-10]].
2. **to bring forth**;
(a) **of women **(Hipp., Arist., al.);
(b) **of the ground **(Hdt.): [[Heb.6.8|Heb.6:8]]†
(AS)

G1630.def:
**ἔκφοβος**, -ον
[in LXX: ἔ. εἶναι for יָגֹר, [[Deu.9.19|Deu.9:19]] also [[1Ma.13.2|1Ma.13:2]] * ;]
**affrighted, terrified**: [[Mrk.9.16|Mrk.9:16]], [[Heb.12.21|Heb.12:21]].†
(AS)

G1606.def:
**ἐκ-πνέω, -ῶ**,
**to breathe out**; sc. βίον, ψυχήν (expressed in cl., Æsch., al.; cf. LS, see word), **to breathe one's last, expire**: [[Mrk.15.37, 39|Mrk.15:37, 39]] [[Luk.23.46|Luk.23:46]]. For force of aorist, see Swete, [[Mrk.15.37|Mrk.15:37]]†
(AS)

G1665.def:
**Ἐλεισάβετ** (T, Rec. Ἐλισ-; see WH, _App._, 155), ἡ indecl. (Heb. אֱלִישֶׁבַע)
**Elizabeth**: [[Luk.1.5|Luk.1:5]] ff.†
(AS)

G1678.def:
**Ἐλμαδάμ** (L, Ἑλ-; Rec. -μωδάμ), ό, indecl.,
**Elmadam, an ancestor of Jesus**: [[Luk.3.28|Luk.3:28]]
(AS)

G1663.def:
**Ἐλιέζερ**(Heb. אֱלִיעֶזֶר), ὁ, indecl.,
**Eliezer, an ancestor of Jesus**: [[Luk.3.29|Luk.3:29]]†
(AS)

G1666.def:
**Ἐλισαῖος** (Rec. Ἐλισσαῖος; Τ, Ἑλισ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. אֱלִישָׁע),
**Elisha, the prophet**: [[Luk.4.27|Luk.4:27]]†
(AS)

G1685.def:
**ἐμ-βάλλω **
[in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;]
**to cast into**: before εἰς, [[Luk.12.5|Luk.12:5]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, vii, 93).†
(AS)

G1669.def:
**ἑλκόω**, -ῶ
1. to wound.
2. **to ulcerate**; pass., **to suffer from sores**: pf. ptcp., εἱλκωμίνος (Rec. ἡλκ-), EV, full of sores, [[Luk.16.20|Luk.16:20]]†
(AS)

G1628.def:
**ἐκ-φεύγω **
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
**to flee away, escape**: absol., [[Act.16.27|Act.16:27]], [[1Th.5.3|1Th.5:3]], [[Heb.2.3|Heb.2:3]]; before ἐκ, [[Act.19.10|Act.19:10]] with accusative of person(s), [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.21.36|Luk.21:36]], [[Rom.2.3|Rom.2:3]]; τ. χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, [[2Co.11.33|2Co.11:33]]†
(AS)

G1695.def:
**Ἐμμαούς**, ἡ
Emmaus, a place 60 furlongs from Jerusalem: [[Luk.24.13|Luk.24:13]]†
(AS)

G1640.def:
**ἐλάσσων (-ττων**, Heb_7:7, WH, 1Ti_5:9), -ον
(formed, with superl. ἐλάχιστος, from the epic ἐλαχύς, little, and serving as compar. of μικρός), [in LXX for מָעַט, etc. ;]
**less, in age, rank or quality**: [[Jhn.2.19|Jhn.2:19]], [[Rom.9.12|Rom.9:12]]" (LXX), [[Heb.7.7|Heb.7:7]] neut., -ον, adverbially: [[1Ti.5.9|1Ti.5:9]]†
(AS)

G1642.def:
**ἐλαττόω**, -ῶ
(ἐλάιττων), [in LXX (where also -σσῶ) chiefly for חָסֵר, and very frequently in Sir ;]
**to make less**: [[Heb.2.7|Heb.2:7]] (LXX); pass., [[Jhn.3.30|Jhn.3:30]], [[Heb.2.9|Heb.2:9]].†
(AS)

G1670.def:
**ἕλκω **
(Hellenistic form ἑλκύω in [[Jhn.11.1-57|Jhn.11:1-57]] with, [[Act.16.19|Act.16:19]]), [in LXX for מָשַׁךְ, etc. ;]
**to draw**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Jhn.18.10; 21.6|Jhn.18:10 21:6]]; with accusative of person(s), before ἔξω, [[Act.21.30|Act.21:30]] εἰς, [[Act.16.19|Act.16:19]], [[Jas.2.6|Jas.2:6]]. Metaphorical, **to draw, lead, impel**: [[Jhn.6.44; 12.32|Jhn.6:44 12:32]]. (For discussion of ἕ. in Oxyrh. Log., see Deiss., _LAE_, 437 ff.)†
(AS)

G1659.def:
**ἐλευθερόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Pro.25.10|Pro.25:10]] [[2Ma.1.27|2Ma.1:27]] [[2Mac.2.22|2Mac 2:22]] * ;]
to make free from sin, [[Jhn.8.32, 36|Jhn.8:32, 36]]; before ἀπό, [[Rom.6.18, 22; 8.2, 21|Rom.6:18, 22 8:2, 21]]; τ. ἐλευθερία (dative commodi), [[Gal.5.1|Gal.5:1]] (on the "punctiliar" force of this verb, see M, _Pr._ 149; cf. also Cremer, 251).†
(AS)

G1639.def:
**Ἐλαμείτης** (Rec. -αμίτης), -ου, ὁ
(Heb. אֵילָם) [in LXX (cl.) Ἐλυμαίος, Ἔλαμος: [[Jdt.1.6|Jdth.1:6]] Ἀιλαμείτης (vv.ll. Ἐλ-, -αμίτης; Bl., § 3, 7): [[Isa.11.11; 21.2; 22.6|Isa.11:11 21:2 22:6]]) ;]
**an Elamite**: [[Act.2.9|Act.2:9]]†
(AS)

G1680.def:
**ἐλπίς **
(ἑλ-, [[Rom.8.20|Rom.8:20]], WH, see Bl., § 4, 3; M, _Pr._, 44), -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX for בָּטַח and its derivatives, תִּקְוָה (frequently in Jb), etc. ;]
expectation (in cl., rarely of evil, mostly of good, and so always in NT), hope;
1. **of hope in general**: [[2Co.1.6|2Co.1:6]] with genitive obj., [[Act.16.19|Act.16:19]] art. inf., [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]]; παρ᾽ ἐλπίδα, [[Rom.4.18|Rom.4:18]] ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]]
2. **Of religious hope**: ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι, [[Act.2.26; 26.6|Act.2:26 26:6]], [[Rom.4.18; 8.20|Rom.4:18 8:20]], [[Tit.1.2|Tit.1:2]]; τῇ ἐ. ἐσώθημεν, [[Rom.8.24|Rom.8:24]] κατ᾽ ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου, [[Tit.3.7|Tit.3:7]] of the Messianic hope of Israel, [[Act.23.6; 26.6-7; 28.20|Act.23:6 26:6-7 28:20]]; of Christian hope, [[Rom.5.2-5; 12.12; 15.4, 13|Rom.5:2-5 12:12 15:4, 13]], [[1Co.13.13|1Co.13:13]], [[2Th.2.16|2Th.2:16]], [[Heb.3.6; 6.11; 7.19; 10.23|Heb.3:6 6:11 7:19 10:23]], [[1Pe.1.3; 1.21; 3.15|1Pe.1:3 1:21 3:15]]; with genitive obj., [[Rom.5.2|Rom.5:2]], [[Col.1.27|Col.1:27]], [[1Th.1.3; 5.8|1Th.1:3 5:8]], [[Tit.1.2|Tit.1:2]]; with genitive of that on which the hope is based, [[Act.26.6|Act.26:6]], [[Eph.1.18; 4.4|Eph.1:18 4:4]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]]; ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἐ., [[Rom.15.13|Rom.15:13]] ἔχειν ἐ. (= cl. ἐλπίζειν), [[Act.24.15|Act.24:15]], [[Rom.15.4|Rom.15:4]], [[2Co.3.12; 10.15|2Co.3:12 10:15]], [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]], [[1Th.4.13|1Th.4:13]]; before ἐπί, with dative, [[1Jn.3.3|1Jn.3:3]] εἰς, [[Act.24.15|Act.24:15]] ὅτι, [[Rom.8.20|Rom.8:20]], [[Php.1.20-21|Php.1:20-21]]. Meton.,
(a) **of the author or ground of hope **(cl.): [[1Th.2.19|1Th.2:19]], [[1Ti.1.1|1Ti.1:1]]; with genitive obj., [[Col.1.27|Col.1:27]]
(b) **of the thing hoped for**: [[Gal.5.5|Gal.5:5]], [[Col.1.5|Col.1:5]], [[Tit.2.13|Tit.2:13]], [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]] (Cremer, 252, 712).†
(AS)

G1634.def:
**ἐκ-ψύχω **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.4.21|Jdg.4:21]] A (עוּף), [[Ezk.21.7|Eze.21:7]] (כָּהָה pi.)* ;]
**to expire, breathe one's last**: [[Act.5.5, 10; 12.23|Act.5:5, 10 12:23]] (cf. ἐκπνέω; Cremer, 906).†
(AS)

G1675.def:
**Ἑλληνιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(Ἑλληνίζω, to Hellenize, affect Greek cus­toms),
**a Hellenist **(RV, Grecian Jew): [[Act.6.1; 9.29; 11.20|Act.6:1 9:29 11:20]].†
(AS)

G1620.def:
**ἐκ-τίθημι **
[in LXX for נָתַן ni., etc. ;]
**to set out, expose**: [[Act.7.21|Act.7:21]], Metaphorical, **to set forth, expound**: [[Act.11.4; 28.23|Act.11:4 28:23]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Act.18.26|Act.18:26]]†
(AS)

G1660.def: **a coming:—;the Advent ** of our LORD, (New Testament) (ML)

G1601.def:
**ἐκ-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.40.8; 28.1, 4|Isa.40:8 28:1, 4]] (הֶבֶל), [[Job.14.2|Job.14:2]] (מָלַל, see RV. mg), [[Job.15.30|Job.15:30]] (סוּר), [[Job.15.33|Job.15:33]] (שָׁלַךְ hi.), etc. ;]
**to fall out of, fall from, fall off**: before ἐκ τ. χειρῶν, [[Act.12.7|Act.12:7]] absol., [[Act.27.32|Act.27:32]] of the withering of flowers (as LXX, ll with), [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]], [[1Pe.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]" (LXX) ; of navigators falling off from a straight course, [[Act.27.17, 26; 27.29|Act.27:17, 26 27:29]] Metaphorical, with genitive of thing(s): [[Gal.5.4|Gal.5:4]], [[2Pe.3.17|2Pe.3:17]]; absol., **fall from its place, fail, perish**: [[Rom.9.6|Rom.9:6]]†
(AS)

G1681.def:
**Ἐλύμας**, -α, ὁ
(Aram. or Arab., cf. _DB_, i, 246 b)
**Elymas**: [[Act.13.8|Act.13:8]]†
(AS)

G1603.def:
**ἐκ-πληρόω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.8.10|2Ma.8:10]], [[3Ma.1.2|3Ma.1:2]] [[3Mac.1.22|3Mac 1:22]] * ;]
1. **to fill full, make up a number**.
2. **to fulfil** (MM, _Exp._, xii; Cremer, 839), [[Act.13.32|Act.13:32]]†
(AS)

G1696.def:
**ἐμμένω **
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. **to abide in**: [[Act.28.30|Act.28:30]]
2. **to abide by, be true to**: before ἐν; τ. πίστει, [[Act.14.22|Act.14:22]] τ. διαθήκῃ, [[Heb.8.9|Heb.8:9]] (LXX); with dative, τ. γεγραμμένοις (dative ptcp. as in legal formula; cf. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, _Exp._, xii): [[Gal.3.10|Gal.3:10]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1613.def:
**ἐκ-ταράσσω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.18.4|Psa.18:4]] (עֵת pi.), [[Psa.88.16|Psa.88:16]] (צוּם), צוּם), [[Wis.17.3-4; 18.17|Wis.17:3-4 18:17]] * ;]
**to throw into great trouble, agitate**: [[Act.16.20|Act.16:20]]†
(AS)

G1671.def:
**Ἑλλάς**, -άδος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Isa.66.19|Isa.66:19]], [[Ezk.27.13|Eze.27:13]] (יָוָן), [[1Ma.1.1|1Ma.1:1]] [[1Mac.8.9|1Mac 8:9]] * ;]
with varying usage as to geographical limits; in NT = 'Αχαία (cf. [[Act.18.12|Act.18:12]]),
**Greece**: [[Act.20.2|Act.20:2]]†
(AS)

G1616.def:
**ἐκ-τένεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἐκτενής), [in LXX: [[Jdt.4.9|Jdth.4:9]], [[2Ma.14.38|2Ma.14:38]], [[3Ma.6.41|3Ma.6:41]] * ;]
**zeal, intentness, earnestness **(cf. Deiss., BS, 262): [[Act.26.7|Act.26:7]]†
(AS)

G1688.def:
**ἐμ-βιβάζω **
[in LXX: [[2Ki.9.23|4Ki.9:23]] (רָכַב hi.), [[Pro.4.11|Pro.4:11]] (דָּרַךְ hi.) * ;]
1. to set in, put in.
2. **to put on board ship, embark**: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[Act.27.6|Act.27:6]]†
(AS)

G1677.def:
**ἐλλογάω**, -ῶ
(a κοινή word, elsewhere usually -έω; cf. Bl., § 22, 2),
**to charge to one's account, impute**: Phm 18 (on parallels, cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 79 f., 335 f.; Milligan, _NTD_, 73; MM, _Exp._, xii); of sin, [[Rom.5.13|Rom.5:13]] (Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

G1635.def:
**ἑκών**, -οῦσα, -όν
[in LXX: [[Exo.21.13|Exo.21:13]], [[Job.36.19|Job.36:19]] * ;]
**willing, of one's own free will**: [[Rom.8.20|Rom.8:20]], [[1Co.9.17|1Co.9:17]] (Cremer, 246).†
(AS)

G1600.def:
**ἐκ-πετάννυμι **
[in LXX chiefly for פָּרַשׂ, as [[Isa.65.2|Isa.65:2]] (hithp.) ;]
**to spread out** (as a sail), **stretch forth**: [[Rom.10.21|Rom.10:21]](LXX).†
(AS)

G1626.def:
**ἔκ-τρωμα**, -τος, τό
(ἐκτιτρώσκω, to miscarry), [in LXX: [[Job.3.16|Job.3:16]], [[Ecc.6.3|Ecc.6:3]] (; also in Aq., [[Psa.58.9|Psa.58:9]], [[Num.12.12|Num.12:12]] (נָפַל) * ;]
**an abortion, an untimely birth **(see Field, _Notes_, 179): [[1Co.15.8|1Co.15:8]]†
(AS)

G1652.def:
**ἐλεεινός**, -ή, -όν
(ἔλεος in Re, l.with, WH have the Attic poëtic form, ἐλεινός),
**pitiable, miserable**: [[Rev.3.17|Rev.3:17]] comparat., [[1Co.15.19|1Co.15:19]]†
(AS)

G1641.def:
**ἐλαττονέω**, -ῶ
(ἔλαττον), [in LXX (with -όω) chiefly for חָסֵר ;]
**to be less **(RV, had no lack): [[2Co.8.15|2Co.8:15]] (LXX) (a rare word; cf. MM, _Exp._, xii).†
(AS)

G1629.def:
**ἐκ-φοβέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for חָרֵד hi. ;]
**to frighten away, terrify**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.10.9|2Co.10:9]]†
(AS)

G1609.def:
**ἐκ-πτύω **
1. **to spit out**.
2. **to spit at in disgust, to abominate, loathe** (= cl. ἀποπτ-, καταπτ-): [[Gal.4.14|Gal.4:14]]†
(AS)

G1625.def:
**ἐκ-τρέφω **
[in LXX for גָּדַל, etc. ;]
1. prop., of children, **to nurture, bring up**: [[Eph.6.4|Eph.6:4]]
2. **to nourish**: [[Eph.5.29|Eph.5:29]]†
(AS)

G1687.def:
**ἐμβατεύω **
[in LXX: with accusative, [[Jos.19.49|Jos.19:49]] (נָחַל, [[Jos.19.51|Jos.19:51]] (חָלַק pi.); before εἰς, [[1Ma.12.25|1Ma.12:25]] [[1Mac.13.20|1Mac 13:20]] [[1Mac.14.31|1Mac 14:31]] [[1Mac.15.40|1Mac 15:40]]; metaphorically, [[2Ma.2.30|2Ma.2:30]] * ;] (ἐμβάτης ἐμβαίνω)
1. to step in or on (Soph.), hence
(a) **to frequent, haunt, dwell in **(Æsch., Eur.); metaphorically, [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] (dwelling in, R, txt.; taking, R, mg.);
(b) to invade (1Mac, ll with; metaphorically, Col, Lc.).
2. **to enter on, come into possession of **(Eur., Dem.; LXX, Jos, H. with); on the difficulties of reading and interpretation in this passage, see Lft, Col., 194 f., 252; _ICC_, 268 ff.; Field, _Notes_, 197; Milligan, _NTD_, 177; and for exx. from π., MM, _Exp._, xii (cf. κενεμβ.).†
(AS)

G1624.def:
**ἐκ-τρέπω **
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, [[Amo.5.8|Amo.5:8]] * ;]
to turn out of the course, turn aside, with accusative Pass., with middle sense, intrans., **to turn aside**: [[Heb.12.13|Heb.12:13]] (R, txt., for be put out of joint, R, mg., see Thayer, see word Westc., in l); figuratively, before εἰς, [[1Ti.1.6|1Ti.1:6]] ἐπί, [[2Ti.4.4|2Ti.4:4]] ὀπίσω, [[1Ti.5.15|1Ti.5:15]] with accusative, **to shun, avoid**: [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]]†
(AS)

G1612.def:
**ἐκ-στρέφω **
[in LXX: [[Deu.32.20|Deu.32:20]], [[Amo.6.13|Amo.6:13]] [[Ezk.16.34|Eze.16:34]] A (הָפַךְ), [[Zec.11.16|Za 11:16]] (פָּרַק pi.), [[Ezk.13.20|Eze.13:20]] (צוּד pi.)* ;]
1. **to turn out of** (Hom.).
2. **to turn inside out**; metaphorically, **to change entirely, pervert** (Aristoph.): [[Tit.3.11|Tit.3:11]]†
(AS)

G1650.def:
**ἔλεγχος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἐλέγχω) [in LXX: frequently in Pr, Jb (יָכַח) יָכַח) [[Wis.5.1-23|Wis.5:1-23]], [[Sir.3.1-31|Sir.3:1-31]], etc. ;]
**a proof, test**: [[Heb.11.1|Heb.11:1]]†
(AS)

G1608.def:
**ἐκ-πορνεύω **
[in LXX chiefly for זָנָה, frequently of spiritual unfaithfulness ;]
strengthened form of πoρνεύω, implying **excessive indulgence**; mid, **to give oneself up to fornication**: [[Jude.7|Ju 7]].†
(AS)
